evals.prompt: Implement the plan at .claude/plan/jwt-auth.md — it adds JWT authentication with refresh tokens to the Express API.
evals.expected_output: Claude reads the plan, implements the changes locally, reviews the diff through acpx with a structured verdict, fixes CRITICAL/HIGH issues, and delivers a summary.
expectations: Claude reads the plan file before implementing
Claude uses Edit or Write tools to modify production files
Claude reads acpx-reviewer-role.md from the skill directory
Claude invokes acpx through Bash for the review phase
The review prompt asks for 'VERDICT: APPROVED | WARNING | BLOCKED'
Claude reuses the same named acpx review session for follow-up review rounds
Claude reports the final review result in delivery

evals.prompt: Add input validation to the registration endpoint — validate email format, password strength, and username length.
evals.expected_output: Claude implements directly from the inline task description, then runs the review through acpx and delivers.
expectations: Claude does NOT require a plan file
Claude calls acpx after implementation
The review prompt tells Codex to inspect git diff HEAD
If Codex returns WARNING or BLOCKED, Claude fixes accepted CRITICAL/HIGH issues before re-reviewing
If MEDIUM/LOW issues remain, Claude asks the user whether to fix them
Delivery includes the changed files and review result

evals.prompt: Add a caching layer to the user service, session service, product service, order service, and notification service.
evals.expected_output: Claude dispatches subagents for the 5+ tasks, then runs a single external review loop through acpx.
expectations: Claude identifies this as 3+ implementation tasks and dispatches Task subagents
Claude records git SHA before each subagent dispatch
Claude runs git diff after each subagent to verify changes
Claude runs scoped lint/tests after each subagent completes
Claude invokes acpx for the final review after all subagents complete

evals.prompt: Add a health check endpoint to the API server.
evals.expected_output: Claude detects that acpx review is unavailable and stops with a clear error message instead of delivering without review.
expectations: Claude checks that acpx or the Codex adapter can start before the review phase
Claude stops and tells the user that this skill requires acpx-backed Codex review
Claude does NOT deliver a completion summary without the review loop
Claude does NOT silently fall back to a non-Codex review
